notes.title: Another patch!
notes.content:
Hello hello, just doing some more ironing
Fixed the doors getting a bit too... excitable when in close contact with the shadow
And also fixed a rare pathfinding issue that would lock it in place permanently

notes.title: Another little update!
notes.content:
Hiiii again, just making some small fixes involving level gen
I also added the controls to the pause menu in case you forget them while playing

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Hi hi, another update; this time more than a hotfix
I'm experimenting with a small checkpoint system that kicks in after your 2nd death, but it only applies to normal mode
Hopefully this helps alleviate some frustrations

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
Another quick hotfix lol
Fixing the lights being shut off in a starting area, and a lab room puzzle not functioning properly

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Another small hotfix for some issues with the monster detecting the flashlight
Also added an extra battery at the start while removing a bonus battery that was hidden

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content: Second hotfix, for real! Fixed a keypad not working, as well as several buttons lacking a cooldown

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
I just realized I didn't update the default branch before haha
Now it's actually updated lmao, Steamworks is confusing

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content: Hey there, just putting out a quick hotfix to address some issues I missed. These include the key spawning in the lab room, the symbol code in the lab room, tweaks to the flashlight so small chairs don't block it, and some pathfinding issues.
